# Data & AI Wiki

> Mirror website for AlexMercedCoder's Data and AI Wiki. A collection of articles on lakehouses, semantic layers, concepts, and platforms.

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/) - Main entry point and directory list.
- [Terms](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/terms/) - Complete list of Data & AI terms.
- [Individuals](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/individuals/) - Key individuals in the Data & AI space.
- [Vendor Platforms](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/vendor-platforms/) - Overview of vendor platforms.

## Wiki Articles

- [ACID](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/acid/) - A set of properties (Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability) that guarantee database transactions are processed reliably.
- [Active Learning](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/active-learning/) - A semisupervised machine learning paradigm where the algorithm selects which unlabeled data points it needs labeled next to improve training efficiency.
- [Ad-hoc Query](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/ad-hoc-query/) - A dynamic, nonpreplanned query created ondemand to answer a specific, onetime business question.
- [Agentic AI](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/agentic-ai/) - An advanced paradigm in Artificial Intelligence where AI models function as autonomous agents capable of planning, using tools, executing complex workflows…
- [Aggregation](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/aggregation/) - A mathematical process where multiple data values are grouped together to form a single summary value, such as Sum, Average, or Count.
- [AI-ism](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/ai-ism/) - A term describing clichéd, repetitive, or sterile phrasing commonly generated by generic AI systems.
- [Airflow](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/airflow/) - An opensource platform developed by Apache to programmatically author, schedule, and monitor workflows.
- [Alex Merced](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/alex-merced/) - Alex Merced is a prominent technologist, developer advocate, educator, and author in the data and AI ecosystem.
- [Analytics Engineer](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/analytics-engineer/) - A professional role that bridges the gap between data engineering and data analysis.
- [ANN (Approximate Nearest Neighbor)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/ann-approximate-nearest-neighbor/) - A class of algorithms designed to search for vectors in highdimensional space that are close to a query vector.
- [Anomaly Detection](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/anomaly-detection/) - The identification of rare items, events, or observations that raise suspicions by differing significantly from the majority of the data.
- [Apache Hudi](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/apache-hudi/) - An opensource transactional data lakehouse table format that provides features like upserts, deletes, and incremental data processing pipelines on top of…
- [Apache Iceberg](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/apache-iceberg/) - An opensource, highperformance transactional table format designed for massive analytic datasets.
- [Apache Polaris](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/apache-polaris/) - An opensource metadata catalog for data lakehouses that supports the Apache Iceberg table format.
- [Apache Spark](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/apache-spark/) - Apache Spark is a popular opensource, distributed generalpurpose clustercomputing framework.
- [Apache Spark Structured Streaming](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/apache-spark-structured-streaming/) - A scalable and faulttolerant stream processing engine built on the Spark SQL engine, allowing streaming queries to be expressed like batch queries.
- [API (Application Programming Interface)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/api-application-programming-interface/) - A set of protocols and tools that allows different software applications to communicate and share data with each other.
- [API Gateway](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/api-gateway/) - A management tool that sits between a client and a collection of backend microservices.
- [Artificial Intelligence](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/artificial-intelligence/) - The simulation of human intelligence processes by machines, especially computer systems.
- [Artificial Neural Network](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/artificial-neural-network/) - A computing system modeled after the human brain's neural structure, containing layers of interconnected nodes used to solve nonlinear learning problems.
- [Athena](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/athena/) - Amazon Athena is an interactive query service that makes it easy to analyze data directly in Amazon S3 using standard SQL.
- [Attention Mechanism](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/attention-mechanism/) - A key architecture component in modern deep learning (specifically Transformers) that allows models to dynamically focus on specific parts of an input…
- [Autoencoder](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/autoencoder/) - A type of unsupervised artificial neural network used to learn efficient data codings or compressions by training the network to ignore signal noise.
- [Avro](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/avro/) - Apache Avro is a roworiented data serialization system that provides rich data structures and a compact, fast, binary data format.
- [AVX-512](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/avx-512/) - A set of CPU instructions that support advanced vector extensions, frequently utilized to accelerate vector search calculations and machine learning inference.
- [AWS (Amazon Web Services)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/aws-amazon-web-services/) - The world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform, offering over 200 fully featured services from data centers globally, including computing…
- [AWS Glue](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/aws-glue/) - A serverless data integration service that makes it easy to discover, prepare, and combine data for analytics, machine learning, and application development.
- [Azure (Microsoft Azure)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/azure-microsoft-azure/) - Microsoft's cloud computing platform providing a wide range of cloud services, including analytics, virtual computing, database management, and AI services…
- [Azure Blob Storage](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/azure-blob-storage/) - A scalable object storage service provided by Microsoft Azure, designed to store massive amounts of unstructured data, such as text or binary data, for…
- [Backpropagation](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/backpropagation/) - The primary algorithm used to train artificial neural networks.
- [Bag-of-Words](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/bag-of-words/) - A simple text representation model used in NLP where a text document is represented as an unordered bag or set of its words, ignoring grammar and word order.
- [BASE](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/base/) - An acronym standing for Basically Available, Soft state, Eventual consistency.
- [Batch Size](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/batch-size/) - A hyperparameter in machine learning that specifies the number of training samples processed in one iteration before the model's internal parameters are updated.
- [Bfloat16](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/bfloat16/) - Brain Floating Point 16bit format, a truncated version of the 32bit float format designed to accelerate machine learning computations and save memory.
- [BI (Business Intelligence)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/bi-business-intelligence/) - A technologydriven process for analyzing data and delivering actionable information to help executives, managers, and workers make informed business decisions.
- [Bias-Variance Tradeoff](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/bias-variance-tradeoff/) - A fundamental concept in machine learning describing the tension between error from erroneous assumptions (bias) and error from sensitivity to small…
- [BigQuery](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/bigquery/) - Google Cloud's fully managed, serverless, highly scalable enterprise data warehouse.
- [Blob Storage](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/blob-storage/) - A category of cloud storage optimized for storing unstructured binary large objects (blobs) such as videos, audio, backups, and large analytical datasets.
- [Boosting](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/boosting/) - An ensemble machine learning technique that trains weak learners sequentially, with each new model focusing on correcting the errors of its predecessor.
- [Bootstrap Aggregating (Bagging)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/bootstrap-aggregating-bagging/) - An ensemble machine learning metaalgorithm designed to improve the stability and accuracy of algorithms, reducing variance and avoiding overfitting.
- [Business Glossary](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/business-glossary/) - A centralized directory containing definitions of business terms, concepts, and relationships, separate from physical database table schema catalogs.
- [Cache](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/cache/) - A hardware or software component that stores data temporarily so that future requests for that data can be served faster.
- [Catalog](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/catalog/) - In database systems, a catalog is a metadata repository containing definitions of database objects such as tables, views, columns, and security privileges.
- [CDC (Change Data Capture)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/cdc-change-data-capture/) - A set of software design patterns used to determine, track, and capture changes made to databases (inserts, updates, deletes) in realtime, allowing…
- [CDN (Content Delivery Network)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/cdn-content-delivery-network/) - A geographically distributed group of servers that work together to provide fast delivery of internet content, minimizing page load delays by caching assets…
- [Classification](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/classification/) - A supervised machine learning task where the model categorizes incoming input data points into predefined discrete classes or labels.
- [ClickHouse](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/clickhouse/) - An opensource, highperformance columnar database management system designed for realtime analytics.
- [Cloud Storage](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/cloud-storage/) - A cloud computing model that stores data on the Internet through a cloud computing provider who manages and operates data storage as a service, offering…
- [Clustering](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/clustering/) - In databases, clustering refers to organizing table storage based on the values of one or more columns, ensuring related data is physically colocated to…
- [Clustering Algorithm](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/clustering-algorithm/) - An unsupervised learning method that groups data points into clusters based on similarity metrics, such as KMeans or DBSCAN. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Colocation](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/colocation/) - The physical placement of computing power, data engines, or storage resources within the same data center to minimize network latency.
- [Columnar Database](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/columnar-database/) - A database management system that stores data tables by column rather than by row.
- [Compaction](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/compaction/) - The process of reorganizing storage files in transactional data lakes or databases.
- [Compaction Job](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/compaction-job/) - A scheduled worker process that rewrites transactional log files to optimize query execution times. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Compute-Storage Separation](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/compute-storage-separation/) - An architectural pattern in modern data platforms where storage resources and query engines are scaled and paid for independently, preventing resource…
- [Computer Cluster](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/computer-cluster/) - A set of loosely or tightly connected computers that work together as a single system, essential for executing distributed query engines like Spark or Trino.
- [Computer Vision](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/computer-vision/) - A field of artificial intelligence that trains computers to interpret and understand the visual world.
- [Consensus Protocol](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/consensus-protocol/) - A system in distributed computing used to achieve agreement on a single data value or system state among multiple unreliable nodes, ensuring system…
- [Containerization](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/containerization/) - A lightweight virtualization method that packages an application and its dependencies into a single container image, executed uniformly across environments.
- [Context Window](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/context-window/) - The maximum amount of text (measured in tokens) that a Large Language Model can process in a single prompt and response interaction.
- [Copy-on-Write](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/copy-on-write/) - A storage optimization and write strategy where data files are never modified in place.
- [Correlation](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/correlation/) - A statistical relationship indicating how closely two variables fluctuate together, ranging from perfect positive correlation to perfect negative correlation.
- [Cosine Similarity](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/cosine-similarity/) - A metric used to measure how similar two vectors are, calculated as the cosine of the angle between them in a multidimensional space.
- [Cross-Validation](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/cross-validation/) - A resampling method used to evaluate machine learning models by partitioning data into training and validation folds to obtain stable metrics.
- [DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/dag-directed-acyclic-graph/) - A structural representation of a set of tasks where edges indicate execution order and dependencies.
- [Dagster](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/dagster/) - A modern cloudnative orchestrator for machine learning, analytics, and ETL.
- [Dashboard](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/dashboard/) - A visual interface that displays key performance indicators (KPIs), metrics, and analytical data points to summarize the health and performance of an…
- [Data Analyst](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-analyst/) - A professional who collects, cleans, processes, and performs statistical analyses on data to help businesses make datadriven decisions and generate reports…
- [Data Asset](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-asset/) - Any structured or unstructured data file, table, database, or dashboard that holds business value and is managed within an organization.
- [Data Catalog](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-catalog/) - A detailed inventory of all data assets in an organization, using metadata to help data professionals quickly locate, evaluate, and manage datasets for various projects.
- [Data Cube](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-cube/) - A multidimensional representation of data used in business intelligence for fast analysis.
- [Data Democratization](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-democratization/) - The process of making data accessible to nontechnical users within an organization without requiring specialized assistance from IT or data engineering teams.
- [Data Engineer](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-engineer/) - A specialist who designs, builds, tests, and maintains data pipelines, data warehouses, and data architectures, ensuring that data is clean, reliable, and…
- [Data Fabric](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-fabric/) - An architectural design that connects and manages data across various systems, cloud environments, and physical locations, utilizing metadata to automate…
- [Data Federation](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-federation/) - A data management technique that allows users to query data from multiple disparate sources as if they were a single database, without needing to copy or…
- [Data Governance](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-governance/) - A collection of practices and processes which ensure the formal management of data assets within an organization, covering security, privacy, compliance, and cataloging.
- [Data Ingestion](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-ingestion/) - The process of importing, loading, and transferring raw data from external source systems into a data warehouse or data lakehouse storage repository.
- [Data Lake](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-lake/) - A centralized repository that allows you to store all your structured, semistructured, and unstructured data at any scale, typically using cloud object storage.
- [Data Lakehouse](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-lakehouse/) - An emerging data management paradigm that combines the lowcost object storage scalability of a data lake with the transactional capabilities, ACID…
- [Data Lakehouse Catalog](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-lakehouse-catalog/) - The software interface that tracks transaction log structures, namespaces, and metadata file locations in a modern data lakehouse.
- [Data Lineage](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-lineage/) - A map of the data's journey, showing its origin, the transformations it underwent, and its final destination across various systems and pipelines, crucial…
- [Data Lineage Graph](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-lineage-graph/) - A visual graph representing the transformation steps, source origins, and destinations of data columns. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Data Marketplace](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-marketplace/) - An online platform where organizations can publish, sell, license, or purchase standardized datasets and analytical products. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Data Mart](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-mart/) - A subset of a data warehouse focused on a single functional area, department, or subject, designed to provide data quickly to a specific group of users.
- [Data Mesh](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-mesh/) - A decentralized data architecture that organizes data by business domains rather than central pipelines.
- [Data Modeling](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-modeling/) - The process of defining the structure, relationships, constraints, and data formats of a database or data warehouse to ensure efficient queries and consistent storage.
- [Data Pipeline](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-pipeline/) - A series of automated data processing steps that moves data from a source system to a destination system, transforming and cleaning it along the way.
- [Data Quality](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-quality/) - The measurement of data's accuracy, completeness, reliability, and relevance for business operations and analytical decisionmaking.
- [Data Refresh](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-refresh/) - The scheduled process of updating data warehouses, data marts, or dashboards with the latest records fetched from transaction systems.
- [Data Retention](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-retention/) - The policies and technical configurations governing how long records and tables are preserved in storage before deletion. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Data Science](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-science/) - An interdisciplinary field combining statistics, programming, and domain expertise to extract insights and build predictive models from data.
- [Data Scientist](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-scientist/) - A professional who applies advanced analytics, statistics, machine learning, and predictive modeling to solve complex business problems and uncover hidden insights.
- [Data Sharing](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-sharing/) - The ability to securely share database tables or lakehouse datasets with external partners or departments without copying files.
- [Data Silo](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-silo/) - An isolated pocket of data within an organization that is accessible to one department but cut off from the rest of the company.
- [Data Source](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-source/) - The primary origin of data, such as transaction databases, application APIs, log files, or IoT sensors, imported into analytical engines.
- [Data Sovereignty](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-sovereignty/) - The concept that digital data is subject to the laws and governance structures of the country in which it is physically located.
- [Data Steward](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-steward/) - A role responsible for maintaining the quality, metadata, and security policies of datasets, acting as the custodian of data assets.
- [Data Stewardship](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-stewardship/) - The operational responsibility for managing data assets, ensuring data quality, metadata cataloging, and policy compliance. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Data Transformation](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-transformation/) - The process of cleaning, converting, and formatting raw data into structured tables optimized for reporting and analysis. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Data Virtualization](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-virtualization/) - An approach to data management that allows applications to retrieve and manipulate data without requiring technical details about the data, such as how it is…
- [Data Warehouse](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/data-warehouse/) - A centralized, highly structured repository designed to support business intelligence activities, query analysis, and transactional reporting across historical datasets.
- [Database Index](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/database-index/) - A structured pointer table created on columns to speed up value filtering at the expense of disk space. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Databricks](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/databricks/) - A unified, cloudbased data platform built on top of Apache Spark, Delta Lake, and MLflow, designed for data engineering, collaborative data science, and…
- [DBT (Data Build Tool)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/dbt-data-build-tool/) - An opensource commandline tool that enables data analysts and engineers to transform data in their warehouses using SQL select statements, supporting version…
- [Decoder](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/decoder/) - The component of a sequencetosequence model (like Transformers) that takes encoded representations and generates output sequences token by token, widely used…
- [Deep Learning](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/deep-learning/) - A subset of machine learning based on artificial neural networks with multiple layers (deep networks).
- [Deep Neural Network](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/deep-neural-network/) - An artificial neural network containing multiple hidden layers between input and output layers, capable of learning highlevel features.
- [Delta Lake](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/delta-lake/) - An opensource transactional table format created by Databricks that provides ACID transactions, scalable metadata handling, and unified streaming and batch…
- [Denormalization](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/denormalization/) - A database optimization technique where redundant data is intentionally added to a schema to improve query performance by reducing the number of complex…
- [Differentiable Programming](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/differentiable-programming/) - A programming paradigm where programs can be differentiated, allowing parameters to be optimized using gradient descent, common in deep learning.
- [Dimension Table](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/dimension-table/) - A key component in dimensional modeling (star schemas) containing descriptive attributes (dimensions) like customer name or product category, used to filter…
- [Dimensional Modeling](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/dimensional-modeling/) - A database design technique optimized for analytical queries, organizing data into star or snowflake schemas containing fact and dimension tables.
- [Distributed Database](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/distributed-database/) - A database system that consists of two or more files located in different physical sites, either on the same network or entirely different networks, designed…
- [Distributed Query](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/distributed-query/) - A query executed across multiple database instances or cluster computing nodes in parallel. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Docker](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/docker/) - An opensource platform that automates the deployment of applications inside lightweight, portable software containers, ensuring consistency across…
- [Document Store](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/document-store/) - A type of NoSQL database designed to store, retrieve, and manage semistructured data as document objects, typically formatted in JSON or XML (e.g., MongoDB).
- [Dot Product](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/dot-product/) - An algebraic operation that takes two equallength sequences of numbers (usually coordinate vectors) and returns a single number.
- [Double-bracket link](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/double-bracket-link/) - A wikistyle link format (e.g. Target Page) used to connect pages within a wiki.
- [Dremio](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/dremio/) - Dremio is a highperformance, open and unified SQL Data Lakehouse engine.
- [DuckDB](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/duckdb/) - An opensource, embedded columnar database management system designed for analytical query processing.
- [ELT (Extract, Load, Transform)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/elt-extract-load-transform/) - A data integration process where raw data is extracted from source systems, loaded directly into a target storage system (like a data warehouse), and…
- [Embedding](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/embedding/) - A representation of realworld objects (such as words, documents, or images) as dense numerical vectors in a continuous, highdimensional space, capturing…
- [Embedding Layer](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/embedding-layer/) - A layer in a neural network that translates discrete tokens or categorical features into dense, lowdimensional vector representations.
- [Embedding Model](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/embedding-model/) - A specialized machine learning model trained to convert inputs (text, images) into vector embeddings while preserving semantic relations.
- [Encoder](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/encoder/) - The component of a neural network (such as a Transformer) that processes input data and converts it into a highdimensional contextual vector representation…
- [Entity Resolution](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/entity-resolution/) - The process of identifying and linking records across disparate datasets that refer to the same realworld entity, such as a customer.
- [Epoch](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/epoch/) - One complete pass of the entire training dataset through a machine learning model's training algorithm. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [ETL (Extract, Transform, Load)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/etl-extract-transform-load/) - A traditional data integration process where data is extracted from source systems, transformed and cleaned on an external staging server, and then loaded…
- [ETL Metadata](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/etl-metadata/) - Data about data generated during integration processes, detailing pipeline execution times, raw row counts, transformed column schemas, and pipeline status.
- [Euclidean Distance](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/euclidean-distance/) - The straightline distance between two points in Euclidean space. In vector search, it is used to measure the dissimilarity between two vector representations.
- [Event-driven Architecture](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/event-driven-architecture/) - A software architecture pattern where decoupled services react to events generated by other parts of the system in realtime, often using brokers like Kafka.
- [Execution Plan](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/execution-plan/) - A sequence of operations generated by a database engine's query optimizer to retrieve or update data, detailing indexes used, join algorithms, and execution costs.
- [Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/exploratory-data-analysis-eda/) - An approach to analyzing datasets by summarizing their main statistical characteristics, often using visual methods like plots. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [F1 Score](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/f1-score/) - A statistical metric used to measure the accuracy of a binary classification model.
- [Fact Table](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/fact-table/) - The central table in a dimensional model (star schema) that stores quantitative metrics and measurements (facts) along with foreign keys referencing dimension tables.
- [False Negative](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/false-negative/) - A classification error where a model incorrectly predicts the negative class for a positive data point. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [False Positive](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/false-positive/) - A classification error where a model incorrectly predicts the positive class for a negative data point. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Feature Engineering](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/feature-engineering/) - The process of selecting, manipulating, and transforming raw data into new, informative features that improve the predictive performance of a machine learning algorithm.
- [Feature Selection](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/feature-selection/) - The machine learning preprocessing step of selecting the most informative variables to train an algorithm. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Feature Store](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/feature-store/) - A centralized repository for storing, managing, and serving curated machine learning features, ensuring consistency between offline model training and online…
- [Feature Vector](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/feature-vector/) - An ndimensional vector of numerical features that represents some object, used as input for machine learning models. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Federated Query Engine](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/federated-query-engine/) - A distributed query processor (e.g. Trino) that executes SQL queries spanning multiple external databases without copying data. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Few-Shot Learning](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/few-shot-learning/) - A machine learning scenario where a model is trained or prompted to perform a task using only a small number of training examples.
- [Fine-tuning](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/fine-tuning/) - The process of taking a pretrained machine learning model and training it further on a smaller, taskspecific dataset to adapt its capabilities to a specialized domain.
- [Fivetran](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/fivetran/) - Fivetran is a commercial cloudbased data integration platform that automates the extraction and loading of data from various sources (SaaS applications…
- [Flink (Apache Flink)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/flink-apache-flink/) - An opensource, distributed stream processing framework engine designed to process continuous streams of data with low latency, high throughput, and stateful…
- [Fully Connected Layer](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/fully-connected-layer/) - A layer in an artificial neural network where each node is connected to every node in the preceding layer. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [GCP (Google Cloud Platform)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/gcp-google-cloud-platform/) - Google's suite of cloud computing services, providing infrastructure, data analytics, storage, databases, and machine learning tools running on the same…
- [Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/generative-adversarial-network-gan/) - A machine learning architecture where two neural networks (Generator and Discriminator) compete to create realistic synthetic data.
- [Generative AI](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/generative-ai/) - A branch of artificial intelligence focused on creating new content, including text, images, code, and music, by training models on massive datasets of…
- [Glowmorphism](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/glowmorphism/) - A visual design aesthetic using bright neon highlights, glowing borders, and dropshadows over dark translucent backdrops to build futuristic, highcontrast…
- [Google Cloud Storage](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/google-cloud-storage/) - A global, secure, and scalable object storage service offered by Google Cloud Platform, optimized for serving website content, backups, and large analytics files.
- [GPT (Generative Pre-trained Transformer)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/gpt-generative-pre-trained-transformer/) - A family of decoderonly transformer language models trained on massive text corpora to perform diverse text generation tasks. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [GPU (Graphics Processing Unit)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/gpu-graphics-processing-unit/) - A specialized electronic circuit designed to rapidly manipulate memory, accelerating machine learning model training and vector math.
- [Gradient Descent](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/gradient-descent/) - An optimization algorithm used to minimize the loss function of a machine learning model by iteratively adjusting the model's weights in the direction of…
- [Graph Database](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/graph-database/) - A NoSQL database that uses graph structures with nodes, edges, and properties to represent and store data, optimized for querying highly connected…
- [GraphQL](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/graphql/) - An opensource data query and manipulation language for APIs, allowing clients to request exactly the data they need and nothing more, reducing network usage.
- [Guardrails](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/guardrails/) - Safety mechanisms and filters applied to Generative AI systems to restrict harmful inputs, block toxic outputs, ensure policy compliance, and reduce hallucinations.
- [Hallucination](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/hallucination/) - A phenomenon where a Generative AI model or Large Language Model generates output that is factually incorrect, nonsensical, or unaligned with its training data.
- [Heuristic](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/heuristic/) - A practical method or rule of thumb used to solve problems quickly, often utilized by query optimizers to draft initial query paths.
- [Hidden Partitioning](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/hidden-partitioning/) - An advanced feature in Apache Iceberg where the table format automatically manages partitioning columns based on source fields, freeing queries from needing…
- [Hive Metastore](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/hive-metastore/) - The traditional centralized metadata catalog for the Apache Hadoop ecosystem, storing structural schema definitions and directory paths for tables in a file system.
- [HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/hnsw-hierarchical-navigable-small-world/) - An stateoftheart graphbased algorithm for Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) search, creating multilayer graphs to achieve extremely fast vector searches in…
- [Hot Tier](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/hot-tier/) - A highperformance storage tier optimized for active data that is queried frequently, utilizing fast SSDs or inmemory caches. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Hudi Timeline](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/hudi-timeline/) - A core log structure in Apache Hudi that tracks all actions performed on a table, providing transactional guarantees and pointintime queries.
- [Hyperparameter](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/hyperparameter/) - A configuration parameter in machine learning whose value is set before the training process begins (e.g., learning rate, batch size), governing how the model learns.
- [IaC (Infrastructure as Code)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/iac-infrastructure-as-code/) - The management and provisioning of infrastructure resources (servers, databases, networks) through machinereadable configuration files rather than manual…
- [IAM (Identity and Access Management)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/iam-identity-and-access-management/) - A framework of policies and technologies for ensuring that the right people and systems have the appropriate access to technology resources in a cloud environment.
- [Iceberg Manifest](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/iceberg-manifest/) - An Avroformatted file in an Apache Iceberg table that lists individual data files and documents filelevel statistical bounds. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Iceberg REST Catalog](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/iceberg-rest-catalog/) - A standardized REST API specification for managing Apache Iceberg tables.
- [In-database Analytics](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/in-database-analytics/) - Executing analytical algorithms and machine learning models directly inside a database engine, avoiding data export delays. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [In-memory Database](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/in-memory-database/) - A database management system that primarily relies on main memory (RAM) for data storage, resulting in ultrafast read and write operations compared to diskbound storage.
- [Incremental Load](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/incremental-load/) - An ETL/ELT process that updates a target database by loading only new or changed records since the last execution, saving time. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Indexing](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/indexing/) - A database performance optimization technique that creates data structures (indexes) on table columns to accelerate search and filter speeds at the cost of…
- [Inference](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/inference/) - The process of running a trained machine learning model on new, unseen data to generate predictions, classifications, or generated content.
- [Internet of Things (IoT) Data](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/internet-of-things-iot-data/) - Continuous streams of sensor readings, telemetry, and status updates generated by physical devices connected to the internet. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [IVF-FLAT](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/ivf-flat/) - An inverted file index algorithm used in vector databases to speed up similarity searches by clustering vectors into clusters, querying only the centroids…
- [JSON (JavaScript Object Notation)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/json-javascript-object-notation/) - A lightweight, textbased datainterchange format that is easy for humans to read and write and easy for machines to parse. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [JSON-LD](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/json-ld/) - A method of encoding Linked Data using JSON, widely utilized to embed structured metadata schemas into website pages for search engine optimization.
- [K-Means Clustering](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/k-means-clustering/) - A popular unsupervised clustering algorithm that partitions data into K distinct clusters based on Euclidean distance to centroids.
- [K-Nearest Neighbors](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/k-nearest-neighbors/) - A nonparametric machine learning algorithm used for classification and regression, where a data point is classified based on the plurality vote or average…
- [Kafka (Apache Kafka)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/kafka-apache-kafka/) - An opensource distributed event streaming platform used by thousands of companies for highperformance data pipelines, streaming analytics, and system integration.
- [Kafka Connect](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/kafka-connect/) - A component of Apache Kafka designed to simplify integration between Kafka topics and external data sources or databases. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Key-Value Store](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/key-value-store/) - A simple NoSQL database that uses an associative array (map) as its fundamental data model, storing data as a collection of unique keys linked to specific values.
- [KPI (Key Performance Indicator)](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/kpi-key-performance-indicator/) - A quantifiable measure used to evaluate the success of an organization, employee, or project in meeting objectives. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Kubernetes](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/kubernetes/) - An opensource container orchestration system for automating software deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications across clusters of host machines.
- [Lakehouse Catalog](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/lakehouse-catalog/) - The metadata catalog interface that tracks transactional table namespaces and physical files in a data lakehouse, coordinating safe concurrent engine access.
- [Lakehouse Storage](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/lakehouse-storage/) - The open cloud object storage layer that houses transactional parquet or orc tables managed by formats like Iceberg. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.

- [Large Language Model](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/large-language-model/) - A type of artificial intelligence model trained on massive amounts of text data, capable of understanding, generating, translating, and summarizing human language.
- [Latent Space](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/latent-space/) - A compressed mathematical space where similar data points are grouped closer together, capturing the hidden features of input data.
- [Linear Regression](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/linear-regression/) - A basic supervised learning algorithm that models the relationship between dependent and independent variables using a straight line.
- [Llama](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/llama/) - A family of opensource foundational large language models developed by Meta, widely used for local LLM deployment and custom finetuning.
- [LlamaIndex](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/llamaindex/) - A data framework for connecting private custom data sources to large language models, facilitating retrievalaugmented generation (RAG) and semantic indexing.
- [LLM Prompting](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/llm-prompting/) - The practice of submitting contextrich instruction templates to Large Language Models to shape output generation. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Load Balancer](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/load-balancer/) - A networking device or software that distributes incoming network traffic across a group of backend servers to optimize resource utilization and prevent overload.
- [Logistic Regression](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/logistic-regression/) - A classification algorithm used to predict the probability of a binary outcome based on input features. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.

- [Machine Learning](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/machine-learning/) - A branch of artificial intelligence focused on building systems that learn from data, identify patterns, and make decisions with minimal human intervention.

- [Materialized View](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/materialized-view/) - A database object containing the precomputed results of a query, stored physically on disk to avoid reevaluating complex queries, with various strategies for…
- [Materialized View Refresh](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/materialized-view-refresh/) - The technique used to synchronize precalculated views with incoming transaction write updates. Part of the Data & AI Terms glossary.
- [Merge-on-Read](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/merge-on-read/) - A write strategy in transactional table formats where updates and deletes are written to separate log files (delete files).
- [Monte Carlo](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/monte-carlo/) - Monte Carlo is an enterprise data observability platform designed to track, alert, and resolve issues related to data quality and reliability.
- [Open Source Tools](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/open-source/) - Welcome to the Open Source Tools section of the Data & AI Wiki.

- [Snowflake](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/snowflake/) - Snowflake is a fully managed, cloudnative data platform that functions primarily as an enterprise Data Warehouse.
- [Trino](https://dataaiwiki.com/wiki/trino/) - Trino is an opensource, distributed SQL query engine designed for lowlatency adhoc querying and analytics over largescale datasets.
